Key points
• Dietary protein intakes can vary markedly throughout the life cycle within healthy diets according to the balance between
plant-based or animal-source foods so that identifying the lower limit of the healthy range is challenging.
• The metabolic model for the protein requirement identiﬁes the cellular metabolic demand, which includes obligatory and
adaptive components. The dietary requirement is an intake which meets the demand after adjusting for digestibility and
